authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3865 khādati gives khā-/khāv-/khāvan eat, including Palula khūm. Section 2 khādita expressly includes Nepali khāyo ate; the Dotyali past is assigned to that participle. Unclear p-bearing responses are held. Reviewed comparison: Hajong kʰava “to eat” (f_kk6ggfydbvw46). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
